story.title: The House of Curiosities, an unique immersive experience
story.poster_alt: Svengali theater poster showing mysterious masked performers in ornate frame
story.paragraph1: The company Abra-Cadabra, creator of the well acclaimed experimental cocktail lounge in Kyoto, l'Escamoteur Bar, invites you to experience their second chapter.
story.paragraph2: The House of Curiosities offers a unique theater experience, a strange, intimate, and freaky cabaret where boundaries between the stage and audience vanish.
story.paragraph3: Each evening, Svengali hosts various talented artists, making each night in central Kyoto unique and cinematic.
story.paragraph4: Step into the world of Svengali, a transformative journey blending circus, the world of magic and storytelling.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: At what time the gathering is starting?
faq.a1: Doors open 30 minutes before the show. Please arrive no later than, 20 minutes before it begins.
faq.q2: Can I enter after the show started?
faq.a2_p1: No, once the show starts, the doors will be closed and unfortunately no one will be allowed to enter after that point.
faq.a2_p2: It is important to arrive before the show begins to ensure you have a seat and don't miss any part of the performance. This show is a journey with story-telling, and to fully experience the narrative, it is crucial to be present from the beginning.
faq.a2_p3: Please plan to arrive early to avoid any inconvenience.
faq.q3: I don't have reservation is walk in ok?
faq.a3_p1: Seriously? Are you checking this question?
faq.a3_p2: We wrote it everywhere for you!
faq.a3_p3: No, walk-ins are not allowed because is a reservation-only system.
faq.a3_p4: Please make sure to secure a reservation in advance to attend the show.
faq.q4: Is the show every night the same?
faq.a4: No, the gathering is different every night. We are pleased to present top-level artists, Including world champions and most of them are medalists. The show always feels special, as we host both Japanese and international guest artists. Each evenings offers a unique experience!
faq.a5_p1: The story will be told in both Japanese and English.
faq.a5_p2: However, the show is designed to be enjoyable and talk-free, so regardless of language, the experience will be captivating and accessible to all.
faq.q6: Is there any dress code to attend the gathering?
faq.a6_p1: No, there isn't a specific dress code for attending the gathering.
faq.a6_p2: However, we really encourage people to enjoy the event and come in their best outfits to make it a memorable occasion! As part of this gathering, you'll experience an immersive event where you are the guest of Svengali.
faq.q7: Mask have to be worn during the show?
faq.a7_p1: Yes, masks are an integral part of the story and the gatherings of Svengali, so they must be worn during the show.
faq.a7_p2: Additionally, a robe or cape will be rented to you for the occasion and must be worn.
faq.a7_p3: All our masks are handcrafted by talented artisans in Venise and are disinfected after each use to ensure they are bacteria-free.
faq.q8: I wear glasses can I have a mask?
faq.a8: Yes, we will provide masks specifically designed for glasses users. They are made to be comfortable to wear, ensuring you can enjoy the show without any discomfort.
faq.q9: Is there better seat for tall persons?
faq.a9: Yes, it is preferable to reserve a seat on the 1st floor. You will find it more comfortable.
faq.q10: Do I have to pay extra for the drinks?
faq.a10: No, cocktails and champagne are included in the entry price.
faq.q11: Is it possible to drink while having a mask on?
faq.a11: Yes, our mask are designed for you to enjoy also your drinks during the event.
faq.q12: Is kids allowed to the show?
faq.a12: The minimum age required for the show is 16 years old, so unfortunately, kids are not allowed to attend.
faq.q13: Can I smoke at the venue?
faq.a13: No, smoking is not allowed at the venue.
faq.q14: I have some allergies what should I do?
faq.a14: Please inform our staff when arriving at the venue. We will always double check at the entrance with you anyway.
faq.a15: No, unfortunately, the venue and facilities are not arranged or equipped for wheelchair accessibility.
faq.q16: What should I expect to see?
faq.a16: You can expect an incredible experience with amazing artists offering something truly different. The show invites you to enter the unknown, embarking on a transformative journey that takes you from darkness to light.
